semantic.justification: Native wwFont FFN identity and implicit copy preserve primary/alternate mapping,65unit limit, byte narrowing, pitch/family flags, legacy weight400 and charset. Original memcmp+UTF16-name ordering defines map identity. wwFontHelper copies inserted map keys, assigns narrowed insertion IDs and materializes vectors by ID rather than sorted order. No font DTO/provider or invented ID callback. Font-table initialization through MSWordExportBase, DOCX/XML/embedding, binary/RTF output, actual DocxExport association and complete format orchestration remain pending. The current paragraph-style graph uses pinned reserved Word slots and source collection order; full style vocabulary remains unverified.
